# V0.8.22-23

Section: Source

**V0.8.22-23** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on September 13th, 2019.

## V0.8.22

- Fix - Crash with multiple obscured bodies with Huge Radar

## V0.8.23

- Feature - Kinematic Multiplayer
- Feature - Quick Chat

- Rework - New games and Main Menu now have varied weather
- Rework - Wheel grip

- Fix - Distance sensor functioning while damaged

- [Steam Community News](https://steamcommunity.com/games/573090/announcements/detail/2874908663960323379)
